title: rules.json (contract 1.x)
description: The Rules a claim may name with `rule: "0031"`. Published by the monorepo at the candidate tag and handed to the harness with --rules (release dispatch: rules_url). The harness only checks that a named Rule exists in it, and shows its title in the report; it never reads what a Rule says. Derived from RulesFileSchema in src/claims/rules.ts.

version.description: The format of this file. Any other value is refused.

rules.description: Rule id -> the Rule. An id is four digits.

additionalProperties.description: Unknown keys are ignored, so the monorepo can publish more about a Rule than the harness reads.

title.description: What the report shows beside the Rule's number.

digest.description: A digest of the Rule's text, for whoever audits a release. The harness records nothing about it and never compares it.
